_meta.role: reference/fasit agent -- unlimited time/token budget, produces the ground-truth answer the other two arms are scored against; may use quarry itself if helpful and is told to cross-check with more than one method

issues_found.description: The second pre-existing caller of the old free function was not migrated. internal/loomcli/run.go still calls attachArgv(c.reed.Socket(), c.reed.SessionName()), but the loomcli copy of that function (declared at internal/loomcli/bootstrap.go:166 before this change) was deleted along with the reedcli one. Package internal/loomcli -- and therefore cmd/lyx, the whole binary -- fails to compile: internal/loomcli/run.go:295:46: undefined: attachArgv. Functionally it is also the other half of the bug being fixed: lyx loom run / lyx run is the other registered terminal-handover exception (CONSTRAINTS.md:259, docs/overview.md:318) and would keep the bare 5-element attach argv with no client-sized select-layout chained. Fix: c.reed is a *reedengine.Engine (internal/loomcli/cli.go:44), so read term.GetSize(int(os.Stdout.Fd())) and call c.reed.AttachArgv(cols, rows), mirroring internal/reedcli/attach.go:66-71 (and restore the golang.org/x/term import the staged diff removed).
issues_found.evidence: Four independent methods agree. (1) Compiler: go build ./... fails with internal/loomcli/run.go:295:46: undefined: attachArgv; same under GOOS=windows; go vet -tags "integration smoke" fails identically on linux and windows, covering the repo's entire tag set, so it is not a tag-gated blind spot; go test ./... reports build failure for internal/loomcli and cmd/lyx. (2) quarry: quarry symbol attachArgv finds no such symbol anywhere (only bareAttachArgv/chainedAttachArgv/Engine.AttachArgv in internal/reedengine/attach.go), and quarry impact internal/reedengine/attach.go:62:18 lists callers only in internal/reedcli/attach.go:71 and reedengine's own tests -- no loomcli caller; quarry refs --in-file internal/loomcli/run.go attachArgv returns not_found. (3) Manual tag-agnostic grep across .go/.md/.yaml/.yml/.txt/.json for the exact name yields exactly one hit, run.go:295; cross-checked against git grep -n attachArgv HEAD~1, which enumerates the full pre-change reference set (2 declarations, 2 call sites, 2 tests) -- 5 of 6 migrated or deleted, 1 stale. (4) Counterfactual: overlaying HEAD's version of run.go via go build -overlay makes the whole repo build clean (exit 0) and all affected package tests pass, proving line 295 is the only remaining breakage and no second stale caller is masked by the first error.
